new.traits: Quiet imagination with a whole inner sky. You sense what others miss, and your best ideas arrive before words do.
new.fitNote: names that keep your inner sky
new.counterNote: names that bring dawn to your quiet

crescentW.traits: Restless curiosity in motion. You would rather try and be wrong than sit and wonder.
crescentW.fitNote: names that grow with your momentum

firstQ.traits: Decisive and structural. You see the frame before others see the fog.
firstQ.counterNote: names that let flowers through the frame

gibbousWax.traits: Patient hands, exacting eyes. You refine until the thing becomes itself.

full.traits: Warm, expressive, impossible to miss. Rooms change temperature when you walk in.
full.fitNote: names as bright as you are
full.counterNote: names that add deep water to your light

gibbousW.traits: You notice who is struggling before they say it, and you carry more than your share.
gibbousW.fitNote: names that shade others like a tree
gibbousW.counterNote: names that keep some light for yourself

lastQ.traits: You ask the question everyone was avoiding, and you are usually right to ask it.
lastQ.fitNote: names with an edge of thought
lastQ.counterNote: names that let joy answer back

crescentWan.traits: An old soul's calm. You have already made peace with most things, including the dark.
crescentWan.counterNote: names that ring like a bell in the morning

questions.q: A party is ending and half the guests suggest one more place. You:
questions.A: Already grabbed my coat — one more place, absolutely
questions.B: Already said goodnight in my head — home, book, silence

questions.q: After a long week, what actually recharges you?
questions.A: Being around people, even quiet ones
questions.B: Being alone with no obligations at all

questions.q: At a workshop, the facilitator says: form groups. You:
questions.A: Turn to the nearest person and start
questions.B: Hope the smallest group forms around a corner

questions.q: Your phone shows 12 unread messages. You feel:
questions.A: A little spark — something is happening
questions.B: A little weight — I will answer when I have me back

questions.q: Someone asks what the new project could become. You answer with:
questions.A: The vision — where it could go in three years
questions.B: The first step — what gets done on Monday

questions.q: You remember a person mainly by:
questions.A: The feeling and the idea of them
questions.B: What they did, wore, said — specifics

questions.q: Instructions with a diagram or with steps?
questions.A: Give me the concept, I will find the path
questions.B: Give me the steps, in order, numbered

questions.q: In a novel you love most:
questions.A: What it hints at beyond the page
questions.B: The scenes you can picture exactly

questions.q: A friend's plan makes no sense to you. You say:
questions.A: It is honest, at least — feelings count too
questions.B: It is illogical, and here is exactly why

questions.q: Choosing where to eat with a mixed group, you optimize for:
questions.B: Which choice is objectively best value

questions.q: The feedback you find hardest to give is:
questions.B: None — clear feedback is a gift

questions.q: In an argument, your last sentence is usually about:
questions.A: How we got here, and how it feels
A loose list is plenty — let the trip breathe
A landscape of projects in progress
questions.B: Ordered, or it bothers me more than I admit

questions.q: A deadline is 14 days away. You:
questions.A: Feel it, start when it gets real

questions.q: The plan changes last minute. Inside, you:
questions.A: Honestly — a bit alive, a bit curious
questions.B: First annoyed, then I rebuild the plan
